verses.1: In the teaching of the mysteries, before that which is narrated from the book of Fora. For the believers, the mysteries. The teaching of its mysteries according to the word which was from the beginning, and was, and came to be. Which was born, suffered, died, was buried, and rose; he opened the likeness of death. And he raised the dead. He became their nature, like the wine of the assembly of the Holy Spirit, his body for Adam in place of his soul. Who caused his soul to descend into death. By the Spirit for Adam, he saved and gave him life.
